seo_title: How to choose a Shopify store template that actually sells your products
seo_description: The right shopify store template matches your catalog size, loads fast on mobile, and includes features your products actually need - without buying ten apps to fill gaps. Get the full breakdown on my blog. #shopifystoretemplate #shopifytheme #ecommercetips
cta: Get the full breakdown on my blog.

pin_items.title: MATCH YOUR CATALOG SIZE
pin_items.description: A mega-menu theme makes your 25 products look sparse - small collections need templates that feel intentional, not empty.

pin_items.title: TEST ON YOUR ACTUAL PHONE
pin_items.description: Over 70% of ecommerce traffic is mobile - the responsive preview lies, so test on your real phone with cellular data.

pin_items.title: SPEED AFFECTS YOUR REVENUE
pin_items.description: A gorgeous template that takes 4 seconds to load loses to a clean one that loads in under 2 seconds, every time.

pin_items.title: FREE THEMES HAVE LEVELED UP
pin_items.description: For stores under 100 products with simple variants, dawn or sense customized well often outperforms expensive premium themes.

seo_title: Why most Shopify store template choices end in months of frustration
seo_description: Every demo store looks stunning because professionals styled it with perfect photography. Your real products need a template built for your actual catalog and customers. Learn more on my blog. #shopifystoretemplate #shopifystore #ecommerce

pin_items.title: WRONG FIT FOR YOUR PRODUCTS
pin_items.description: A candle maker doesn't need the same checkout flow as a print-on-demand store - choosing based on pretty demos leads to fighting the structure for months.

pin_items.title: SKIPPING THE MOBILE TEST
pin_items.description: Your customer has 90 seconds on their phone during a lunch break - if variant selectors are tiny or checkout is clunky, they're gone.

pin_items.title: BLOATED FEATURES YOU'LL NEVER USE
pin_items.description: Every built-in section you don't touch is code that still loads - a theme with 20 unused features is slower than a minimal one.

pin_items.title: TRUSTING DESIGN REVIEWS ONLY
pin_items.description: Design reviews tell you it looked nice on day one - support reviews tell you what happens when something breaks six months later.

seo_title: The step by step process for choosing a Shopify store template that converts
seo_description: Skip the regret purchases cluttering Shopify forums. This exact evaluation process takes a few hours upfront but saves months of fighting the wrong foundation. The full breakdown is on my blog - go check it out. #shopifystoretemplate #shopifytips #ecommerceseller
image_headline: How to evaluate a Shopify template
cta: The full breakdown is on my blog - go check it out.

pin_items.title: WRITE YOUR STORE PROFILE
pin_items.description: Count your products, project 6-month inventory, note variant complexity - one paragraph before you open any template gallery.

pin_items.title: DEFINE THREE NON-NEGOTIABLES
pin_items.description: Screenshot specific features from stores you admire, then narrow to exactly three must-haves for your business.

pin_items.title: START WITH FREE THEMES
pin_items.description: Preview dawn, sense, taste, studio, and ride with your non-negotiables in mind - test each on your actual phone.

pin_items.title: TRIAL WITH REAL PRODUCTS
pin_items.description: Add the theme in preview mode with your actual photos, descriptions, and variants - not demo content.

pin_items.title: TIME THE PAGE LOAD
pin_items.description: Use pagespeed insights on mobile - if it feels sluggish with limited test products, it'll be worse fully populated.

seo_title: Free vs premium Shopify store templates and when each one makes sense
seo_description: A $350 premium theme used out of the box often performs worse than a free theme customized well. Here's the honest math most sellers skip. Get more info on my blog. #shopifystoretemplate #shopifythemes #smallbusinesstips
cta: Get more info on my blog.

pin_items.title: FREE THEMES ARE ENOUGH WHEN
pin_items.description: Your catalog is under 100 products, variants are straightforward, you don't need advanced filtering, and your photography is strong.

pin_items.title: PREMIUM EARNS ITS PRICE WHEN
pin_items.description: You need robust filtering, have 200+ products with complex categories, or require features that would otherwise need multiple apps.

pin_items.title: THE MATH MOST SELLERS SKIP
pin_items.description: If a premium theme eliminates three apps at $20/month each, it pays for itself in 3 months - but if free does 90%, stop there.

seo_title: From drowning in options to choosing the right Shopify store template for your products
seo_description: Within 15 minutes of browsing, every template looks vaguely the same. This decision framework separates stores that convert from stores that collect dust. #shopifystoretemplate #shopifyecommerce #productbusiness

pin_items.title: YOUR CATALOG DECIDES
pin_items.description: A boutique selling 15 handcrafted ceramics needs completely different structure than a store with 500 phone accessories.

pin_items.title: YOUR CUSTOMERS' 90 SECONDS
pin_items.description: They find your product on Instagram, tap through on their phone, and decide before their meeting starts or their kid interrupts.

pin_items.title: YOUR FOUNDATION MATTERS
pin_items.description: Get it right and your store does the heavy lifting while you focus on products and customers.

pin_items.title: YOUR SPECIFIC PRODUCT TYPE
pin_items.description: Match the template to how your customers actually shop - not the one that looked prettiest in a demo with perfect photography.
